retrievalContext: Microsoft Learn, Azure Architecture Center and the user-provided Azure-Samples Foundry Citadel repository selected for design reuse. AFF-4 must revalidate service capabilities, pin the repository revision and resolve AVM releases before implementation.

sources.title: What is an Azure landing zone?
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses the Microsoft Azure Landing Zone platform/application hierarchy as the foundation of the new Citadel platform; Citadel-specific AI governance and sovereignty overlays are additions, not replacements.

sources.title: Azure landing zone design areas
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses the design-area checklist for identity, organisation, networking, security, governance, management and automation.

sources.title: Define your naming convention
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Adapts CAF resource abbreviations into parameterised Stratton names without inventing tenant-specific standards.

sources.title: Define your tagging strategy
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses governance and cost-management tagging principles; owner and cost centre remain required deployment inputs.

sources.title: Azure Well-Architected Framework
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Uses the five pillars to record explicit benefits, costs and residual risks for each material design decision.

sources.title: Azure Private Endpoint private DNS zone values
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses documented private DNS zone names and central-resolution guidance; zone ownership depends on the chosen landing-zone option.

sources.title: Networking in Azure Container Apps environment
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses internal environments, workload-profile VNet integration and subnet requirements for private application workloads.

sources.title: Reliability in Azure Container Apps
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Adapts availability-zone and replica guidance for the production interactive tier; regional disaster recovery remains conditional on approved locations.

sources.title: Data, privacy, and security for Azure OpenAI Service
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Uses provider statements about prompts, completions and training as evidence input; contractual and configuration checks remain mandatory and no fine-tuning is allowed.

sources.title: Configure Azure OpenAI networking
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses private endpoint and public-network-disable controls for a regional model endpoint.

sources.title: Availability through redundancy - Azure SQL Database
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Supports the production zone-redundant Business Critical starting tier; exact region support must be checked after location approval.

sources.title: Business continuity overview - Azure SQL Database
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses point-in-time restore and failover-group patterns; cross-region failover is withheld until a second approved location exists.

sources.title: Azure Storage redundancy
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Uses ZRS as the in-region production baseline and leaves GZRS/RA-GZRS unavailable until transfer and secondary-location approval.

sources.title: Immutable storage for Azure Blob Storage
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses version-level WORM and legal-hold capabilities for audit evidence; no retention duration is invented.

sources.title: Privileged Identity Management
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses eligible, time-bound privileged role activation with approval and audit.

sources.title: Managed identities for Azure resources
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses managed identities to avoid stored workload credentials.

sources.title: Azure Monitor best practices
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Adapts workspace-based Application Insights, diagnostic settings, action groups and data collection boundaries.

sources.title: Service Bus outages and disasters
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Uses Premium messaging and availability-zone support for production; geo-disaster recovery remains secondary-region dependent.

sources.title: Private endpoint for Azure API Management
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses inbound private connectivity and explicitly disables public network access after private DNS validation.

sources.title: Security in Azure AI Search
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Reuses private access, Entra authorisation, encryption and role separation for the derived evidence index.

sources.title: Azure Policy design area
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Uses policy inheritance and compliance evidence across the confirmed Citadel platform, landing-zone and assurance management groups; exact tenant parent and assignment versions remain parameters.

sources.title: Azure Web Application Firewall on Application Gateway
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Uses prevention mode and a private frontend for internal ingress.

sources.title: Azure pricing calculator

sources.title: Azure Verified Modules - Bicep resource modules

sources.title: Design sovereign policies
sources.sourceStatus: Verified additional Microsoft Sovereign Landing Zone reference supplied in the active interaction.
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Adapts sovereign policy design into Citadel initiatives that deny unapproved locations, public data services, Global/DataZone AI deployments and missing sovereignty evidence while preserving human legal authority.

sources.title: Private Application Gateway deployment
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Uses the generally available private IP-only Application Gateway v2 capability and carries Microsoft.Network/EnableApplicationGatewayNetworkIsolation registration state as fail-closed subscription evidence before AFF-4 can plan private ingress.

sources.title: Automatic, geo-redundant backups - Azure SQL Database
sources.reusedOrAdapted: Azure SQL defaults new database backups to geo-redundant storage in an Azure paired region. Citadel therefore requires explicit requestedBackupStorageRedundancy for every database, restricts production to Local or Zone after approved-region capability evidence, applies the choice to STR and LTR, and denies Geo or GeoZone without a later approved boundary decision.
